answer: A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the bridge graph. Re-attestations are stored in glacier and knoll lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 1392 identities would post 4717 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
